input.hint: The ID of the sign request

actions.name: search_files
actions.title: Search files or folders
actions.description: Search files or folders in Box
actions.help: Searches may not return newly created files or folders in Box due to time delay for indexing files and folders. Specify either Search text or Metadata filters , or both, to perform a search.

input.name: query
input.label: Search text
input.hint: Search against file name, description, contents. File name should include extension, e.g. File.csv

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: Whether you want to search 'file' or 'folder'. Default value is 'file'

input.name: ancestor_folder_ids
input.label: Starting folder
input.hint: Narrow down your search to this folder

input.name: file_extensions
input.label: File extensions
input.hint: Comma separated list of file extensions to include. For example: csv,txt,doc .

input.name: exact_match
input.label: Exact match
input.hint: Whether to search using exact match or partial match. Defaults to No .

input.name: content_types
input.label: Content types
input.hint: Whether to limit the search results to any items that match the Search text for a specific part of the file.

input.name: trash_content
input.label: Trash content
input.hint: Whether the search should look in the trash for items. Default value is 'non_trashed_only'.

input.name: created_at_range
input.label: Created at (range)

properties.name: start
properties.label: Start date
properties.hint: If this field is omitted, anything created before the end date will be returned.

properties.name: end
properties.label: End date
properties.hint: If this field is omitted, the current date will be used as the end date instead.

input.hint: Whether the search results should be limited to any items created within a given date range.

input.name: updated_at_range
input.label: Updated at (range)

properties.name: start
properties.label: Start date
properties.hint: If this field is omitted, anything updated before the end date will be returned.

properties.name: end
properties.label: End date
properties.hint: If this field is omitted, the current date will be used as the end date instead.

input.hint: Whether the search results should be limited to any items updated within a given date range.

input.name: deleted_at_range
input.label: Deleted at (range)

properties.name: start
properties.label: Start date
properties.hint: If this field is omitted, anything deleted before the end date will be returned.

properties.name: end
properties.label: End date
properties.hint: If this field is omitted, the current date will be used as the end date instead.

input.hint: Whether the search results should be limited to any items deleted within a given date range. Returns results only if trashed contents are included in the search (set to Trashed only ).

input.name: size_range
input.label: Size (range)

properties.name: minimum
properties.label: Minimum size
properties.hint: Defines the lower bound of item sizes (in bytes) to return as part of a page of results.

properties.name: maximum
properties.label: Maximum size
properties.hint: Defines the upper bound of item sizes (in bytes) to return as part of a page of results.

input.hint: Whether the search results should be limited to any items with a size within a given file size range. Applies to files and folders.

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Defines the maximum number of items to return as part of a page of results. Maximum allowed value is 200 , defaults to 100 if left unspecified.

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: The offset of the item at which to begin the response. Allowed values are multiples of the limit parameter. Values exceeding 10000 are not allowed.

input.name: sort
input.label: Sort by
input.hint: Defines the order in which search results are returned. Defaults to 'relevance' if left unspecified.

input.name: direction
input.label: Sort direction
input.hint: Defines the direction in which search results are ordered. Defaults to 'descending' order if left unspecified. If results are sorted by 'relevance', the ordering is defaulted to 'descending' and this …

input.name: md_object
input.label: Metadata filter object
input.hint: Choose metadata object to filter based upon. Also specify the Metadata filters input to set filter based on metadata.

output.name: total_count
output.label: Total count
output.hint: Total number of items matching the search query.

actions.name: update_csv_file

input.name: column_separator
input.label: Column delimiter

input.name: file_encoding_type
input.label: File encoding type
input.hint: Default encoding type is set to UTF-8, and typically doesn't need to be changed.

input.name: append
input.label: Append
input.hint: Setting to Yes appends content to existing file, setting to No overwrites the existing file

input.name: column_headers

input.name: template_list

actions.name: upload_file_content
actions.title: Upload file using file contents
actions.description: Upload file using file contents to Box
actions.help: Upload a file to Box by providing contents of the file. Provide file ID to update an existing file, or provide file name to upload a new file.

input.name: body
input.label: File contents
input.hint: File contents can be obtained by using Box's Download file action, or from other actions/trigger.

input.name: file_size
input.label: File size
input.hint: Only required if file is more than 20 MB. Enter the value in bytes.

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Destination folder
input.hint: Only input 'Destination folder' to upload a new file . Leave blank if you want to upload new version of an existing file .

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: Only input `File name` to upload a new file . Leave blank if you want to upload new version of an existing file . File name should include extension, e.g. my_report.csv.

input.name: file_id
input.label: File ID
input.hint: Only input 'File ID' to upload new version of an existing file . Leave blank if you want to upload a new file . File ID can be found in other Box's triggers/actions, or in the URL when you open the fi…

actions.name: upload_file_from_url
actions.title: Upload file using file URL
actions.description: Upload file from public URL to folder
actions.help: Upload a file to Box by providing a public URL where the file can be found. Action will fail if the file name provided already exists when uploading a new file. Use this action to upload file of size less than 50 MB only . If you want to upload file larger than 50MB, use Upload file using file conte…

input.name: url
input.label: Source URL
input.hint: Upload file found at this URL

input.name: file_id
input.label: File ID
input.hint: Use 'File ID' to upload new version to an existing file. Open the required file, ID can be found at the end of URL. Either file ID or folder must be present

input.name: parent_id
input.label: Destination folder
input.hint: Folder to upload file to. Use Destination folder only when uploading a new file. Either folder or file ID must be present.

input.name: filename
input.label: File name
input.hint: Filename should include extension, e.g. New file.csv . If blank, filename will be automatically obtained from source URL. Use filename only when uploading a new file.
